name: Javier Torralbo
headline: Software Engineer · .NET & Cloud-Native · CKAD · Speaker
summary: Software engineer building cloud-native .NET systems. At Verisk I work on the Impact team: modernizing legacy .NET CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps, containerizing applications and test-runner environments, and building a new product from scratch with spec-driven, AI-led development.

I build software people depend on. Diana, the guide RNA design tool I develop on my own for iGEM UMA, produced guides that the team ordered and tested in the lab. A tokenized bond platform I architected on Canton Network turned into my Bachelor's thesis with ioBuilders.

I teach what I build. I co-founded the DevOps & Cloud course at the University of Málaga (~30 students per session), ran a CI/CD workshop for 40 students at Hackers Week, and spoke about .NET Aspire to 50+ people at OpenSouthCode. CKAD-certified, two-time Ada Byron regional programming champion, and president of IAESTE Málaga's Computer Science section.
availability: Málaga, Spain (on-site or hybrid, from January 2027)
